target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test five overlooked rhythmic or structural constructions after a fresh current-release scan. Character changes are allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / UNTERWEGS: https://unterwegsrecs.bandcamp.com/ — Anika Kunst's September 2026 The Power of Presence and the label's current catalogue were screened. The forthcoming four-track release remains a watch because available text supplies packaging, tracklist and tempo listings but no exact-track structural account.

CURRENT / ELEKTROTRIBE: https://elektrotribe.bandcamp.com/album/vault-tracks — all twelve June 2026 Dead Sound — Vault Tracks titles were screened. The release-level UK-garage, broken-beat, experimental and dub-techno range was not converted into exact-track behavior; the release remains a watch.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / NOUS'KLAER: https://ra.co/reviews/24596 and https://nousklaer.bandcamp.com/album/white-heron — all eight White Heron tracks were screened. Konduku — The Restless was retained from the exact review's mid-track dissipation and sudden kick-led reassembly.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / IMPASSE: https://ra.co/reviews/18144 and https://asusu.bandcamp.com/album/trephine — all three Trephine tracks were screened. Asusu — Trephine was retained from the exact review's rolling polyrhythmic techno/bass construction.

ADJACENT / TIMEDANCE: https://ra.co/reviews/22581 and https://timedance.bandcamp.com/album/patina-echoes — all eleven Patina Echoes tracks were screened. Nico — Soft Opening was retained from the exact review's vocal samples and polyrhythmic drums.

ADJACENT AND OVERLOOKED / WELL STREET: https://ra.co/reviews/30787, https://wellstreetrecords.bandcamp.com/album/soft-focus-ep-wsr-003, https://ra.co/reviews/25100 and https://wellstreetrecords.bandcamp.com/album/various-ep-part-2-wsr-va2 — both EPs were screened. Robert Fleck — Echo Chamber and Formant Value — Polycausa were retained from exact-track accounts of skipping dubbed percussion and slippery polyrhythm.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: current Resident Advisor and Bandcamp electronic indexes, the September 2026 Molekül window and current Nous'klaer/Timedance catalogues were screened. Run 60–76 identities, release-level-only descriptions and weaker placement hypotheses stayed below the ranked list.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 44 named tracks and releases across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–76 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Release-level claims were not converted into exact-track behavior.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown. Descriptions of polyrhythm, skipped percussion and transformation are evidence, not flow verdicts.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Konduku — The Restless: strongest complete structural turn, dissipating halfway before kick, bassline and new synths return.
2. Asusu — Trephine: strongest overlooked metric lead, documented as a rolling polyrhythmic techno/bass hybrid.
3. Robert Fleck — Echo Chamber: strongest adjacent broken/dub lead, with kicks and snares that skip and echo across the track.
4. Nico — Soft Opening: strongest adjacent-world lead, documented through vocal samples and polyrhythmic drums.
5. Formant Value — Polycausa: strongest compact Well Street polyrhythmic lead, retained without converting label tags into flow claims.
